        <h3>Nonlinear control & robotics texts</h3>
        <ul class="academic-list">
          <li>
            Siciliano, Sciavicco, Villani, Oriolo. <em>Robotics: Modelling, Planning and Control.</em> Detailed treatment of manipulator Jacobians and control-affine representations.
          </li>
          <li>
            Slotine &amp; Li. <em>Applied Nonlinear Control.</em> Classic text on feedback linearization, drift/input separation, and Lyapunov methods used throughout the AffineDrift analysis.
          </li>
        </ul>
